name: RC-B10-0371/2025 – Recital A – Am 5
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the detention of EU citizens in the occupied areas of Cyprus
part_text: A.whereas the so-called ‘Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus’ (TRNC) is an occupying regime recognised only by Türkiye, is illegal and not internationally recognised, as result of the Turkish invasion of 1974, with UNSC Resolutions 541 and 550 declaring its unilateral declaration null and void;
